recommendation.summary: dsh-feishu-bot 0.19.16 (repo dsh-lark-bot) is a dsh profile bundle that bridges DeepSeek Harness into Feishu/Lark. Node.js >= 22.19 is the declared engines minimum and the README prerequisite; CI (ci.yml, release.yml, cf-pages.yml) configures Node 22 with pnpm 10.33.0, so Node 22 is recorded as ci-tested rather than an explicit author recommendation. The manifest declares dsh.client.platform=web, so the Web settings surface is included; the documented default adapter is `sdk` with switchable `acp` / `headless` / `web`, all recorded as author workflows. No interactive terminal UI is documented, so no TUI plane is selected. Author DSH baseline is 0.1.0-rc.8 (README compatibility section and COMPATIBILITY.md matrix), which differs from the Radar host 0.2.0-rc.2. DSH_LARK_DISABLED=1 and DSH_LARK_GUARDIAN_DISABLED=1 are retained as additional limited Web-plane comparisons. Authenticated Feishu binding, credentials, guardian service and installer flows remain coverage gaps.

All cells share artifactSha256 53692cc42a65e2857215603f930d8a0885a7e4ea48b8c51a6026f00f9747c34b with approved dependency build protobufjs.
